exams.name: Flight Instructor Gyroplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for certificated instructors adding a gyroplane class rating to an existing CFI certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on gyroplane instruction, rotor blade management, autorotation training and student pilot endorsements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for instructors adding a rotorcraft-helicopter rating to a flight instructor certificate already held.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on helicopter teaching methods, settling with power, autorotation instruction and instructor record keeping.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Airplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 20-question test for instrument instructors in another category adding the instrument-airplane instructor rating.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on teaching instrument procedures, approach charts, IFR regulations and partial-panel training for CFII applicants.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 20-question test for instrument instructors adding the instrument-helicopter rating to their instructor certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test covering instrument instruction in helicopters, IFR procedures and instrument student endorsement requirements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors teaching in light-sport airplanes, covering instruction technique and sport pilot rules.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Balloon Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors providing sport pilot training in lighter-than-air balloons under Part 61 Subpart K.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors delivering glider instruction, including launch procedures and soaring safety.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors teaching sport pilot applicants in gyroplanes, covering rotor handling and training methodology.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Lighter-Than-Air Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors in the lighter-than-air airship class, covering buoyancy control and instruction.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors teaching powered parachute sport pilots, covering canopy handling, wind limits and endorsements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors of weight-shift-control trikes covering control inputs, teaching technique and sport pilot limits.

exams.name: Flight Navigator Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on celestial and dead-reckoning navigation, charts and instruments for the FAA flight navigator certificate.

exams.name: Fundamentals of Instructing Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on learning theory, human behaviour, teaching methods and evaluation required of all flight and ground instructor applicants.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Advanced Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test qualifying holders to give ground instruction for any certificate or rating other than instrument.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test for the basic ground instructor certificate, limited to sport, recreational and private pilot instruction.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Instrument Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test qualifying holders to provide ground instruction for the instrument rating and instrument proficiency checks.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian instrument-rated aeroplane pilots seeking the equivalent FAA instrument rating.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering IFR regulations, approach plates, holding procedures, icing and instrument navigation systems.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Foreign Pilot Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test taken by foreign licence holders adding an FAA instrument rating on the basis of a foreign pilot certificate.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian instrument-rated helicopter pilots applying for the FAA instrument-helicopter rating.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on IFR rules, helicopter instrument approaches, weather and navigation for the instrument-helicopter rating.

exams.name: Military Competence Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question regulations test allowing qualified military aeroplane pilots to obtain a civil FAA pilot certificate.

exams.name: Military Competence Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on civil regulations and airspace enabling military helicopter pilots to convert to FAA certificates.
